csrf.reason_header_invalid: invalid token in the X-CSRF-Token header
csrf.reason_not_a_form: no token, and the body is not a form
csrf.reason_form_mismatch: form: the token sent is not the session's (expired session, or page opened before a sign-in)
csrf.reason_form_missing: form: no token in the body nor in X-CSRF-Token
csrf.reason_admin_login_missing: admin sign-in: no token in the form
csrf.reason_admin_login_mismatch: admin sign-in: the token sent is not the session's
csrf.reason_upload: upload: a file arrived before a valid csrf_token field — nothing was written
csrf.token_dropped: csrf token dropped (sign-in or sign-out): pages opened before now hold a dead one
csrf.token_new: new csrf token for this session
csrf.read_token: read the CSRF token from the session
csrf.keep_token: keep the CSRF token in the session
csrf.read_account: read the signed-in account for the CSRF token
csrf.write_token: write a new CSRF token to the session
csrf.set_value: set_value [csrf token received — its check is on the middleware.csrf channel]

session.read_account: read the signed-in account from the session
session.read_flash: read the flash messages from the session
session.read_dashboard_template: read the dashboard template choice from the session
session.decode_user_db: decode session user_id (load from the database)

anti_bot.read_name: read the honeypot field name from the session

https.redirected: request received over HTTP — redirected to HTTPS
https.port80_stopped: HTTP server on port 80 (ACME challenge and HTTPS redirect) stopped

auth.account_not_read: account not read — session kept, request answered 503
auth.admin_account_not_read: admin account not read — session kept, request answered 503

forms.remove_replaced: remove the file a new upload replaced

mailer.init_twice: mailer_init() called multiple times — initial configuration is kept

boot.no_guard: admin sign-in has neither a LoginGuard nor a rate limiter: password attempts are unlimited (`with_login_guard`, `with_rate_limiter`)
boot.options_without_effect: admin list options accepted but shown by no page yet
boot.stylesheets_missing: admin stylesheets of Runique not found: check STATIC_RUNIQUE_PATH
boot.debug_in_prod: DEBUG=true in production: every visitor sees the detailed error pages, and every log channel is on — the logs hold what visitors type in forms (passwords excepted). Turn it off once the problem is found
boot.prune_failed: orphan rights prune failed — stale grants may remain
